threat_event: Attacker logs in to the integrator's portal with the shared password and changes a T-1 recipe dose or alarm limit, causing an unsafe batch
threat_source: Hacktivist or cybercriminal targeting internet-reachable OT
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on cellular gateway; one shared portal login with no MFA; remote desktop service on the HMI with a weak password; no session approval or alerts
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (remote access)
existing_controls: Hardwired emergency stop and T-1 high-temperature cutout; operators present during batches
treatment_plan: Interim: gateway powered off except for sessions the Operations Manager opens and watches (from 2026-09-01). Named portal accounts with MFA; remote desktop service disabled; portal alerts on every new session to the Operations Manager's phone

threat_event: Ransomware delivered by phishing spreads from an office computer over the flat network to the HMI PC and stops blending
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HMI PC on the office network; out-of-support operating system unpatched since 2023; no antivirus on the HMI; no phishing training
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (network architecture)
existing_controls: MSP antivirus and patching on office computers; MFA on email
treatment_plan: Move the HMI PC to its own firewall segment with only printing allowed; application allowlisting on the HMI; phishing training (R-013); replace the HMI PC with a supported model at the 2027 year-end shutdown

threat_event: Malware carried on a USB stick infects the HMI PC
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: USB sticks move recipe files between the office and the HMI with no scanning; no antivirus on the HMI
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (physical access to media)
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: One company USB stick, scanned on an MSP-managed laptop before every use; block other USB storage on the HMI with allowlisting (R-002)

threat_event: Former employee uses the unchanged HMI password, door code, or an old SaaS login
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Terminations informal; shared HMI password and door code unchanged since an operator left on 2026-03-13; former bookkeeper's accounting login active until 2026-07-16
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (account access control)
existing_controls: Keys and laptops collected at exit; accounting login disabled 2026-07-16 when found
treatment_plan: Termination checklist covering SaaS accounts, HMI and portal logins, door code, and keys, done on the last day; change the door code and HMI password now

threat_event: PLC program, HMI project, or recipes cannot be restored after an attack or a hardware failure
threat_source: HMI PC disk failure, ransomware, or integrator file loss
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Only copies are the integrator's 2023 files and a monthly USB recipe export; never restore-tested; no baseline with checksums
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (continuity and recovery plans)
existing_controls: Owner's paper formulation binder (quarterly); integrator 2023 copy
treatment_plan: Integrator delivers the current PLC program and HMI project with checksums; weekly recipe and HMI export to an offline drive and the cloud backup; restore test on a spare panel PC and bench PLC; spare panel PC kept on the shelf

threat_event: Unapproved or mistaken recipe or alarm limit change produces a wrong or hazardous batch
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared HMI login; no change log; no second approval; audit trail switched off
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (policies and change management)
existing_controls: QC check of every batch before packaging; signed paper batch tickets
treatment_plan: Owner approves every recipe and alarm limit change in writing (from 2026-09-01); named HMI logins and the HMI audit trail enabled; monthly change log review by the Owner

threat_event: Compromise of the integrator (its laptop, staff, or portal vendor) reaches the company's PLC and HMI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Integrator holds the only PLC program copy and permanent remote access; service agreement has no security terms, response time, or incident notice
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Add security terms at renewal: named accounts with MFA, no remote access without company approval, notice of security incidents within 24 hours, delivery of current backups, and a 24-hour on-site response commitment

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects a customer payment or a supplier payment to a fraudster
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Office Manager handles payments and bank changes by email; no call-back rule
existing_controls: MFA on email
treatment_plan: Call-back rule for any bank detail change, using a number already on file; phishing training (R-013)

threat_event: Formulations are copied by an outsider through the open share link or a compromised mailbox
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 'Anyone with the link' share on the formulations folder; no data classification
existing_controls: MFA on the suite
treatment_plan: Replace the open link with a named guest account limited to the private-label folder; classify formulations as Restricted (POL-04)

threat_event: The AI batch-optimization feature recommends, or if write-back is switched on writes, settings outside safe limits
threat_source: AI model error or misuse of the shared portal login
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Feature switched on by the integrator in May 2026 without assessment; write-back available behind the shared login; no safe-limit envelope documented
existing_controls: Advisory mode; operators enter settings by hand; hardwired high-temperature cutout
treatment_plan: Assessment and conditions in P10: lock write-back to a named administrator; safe-limit envelope; recommendations limited to non-peroxide recipes

threat_event: Device on the guest Wi-Fi reaches the HMI remote desktop service
threat_source: Visitor, driver, or malware on a guest device
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Guest Wi-Fi not separated from the office network (found in P07 testing on 2026-08-11)
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (network architecture)
existing_controls: Guest Wi-Fi password given only on request
treatment_plan: MSP separates guest Wi-Fi from all company devices (due 2026-09-15); HMI segment (R-002)

threat_event: Hazmat is offered with wrong shipping paper data, or the ERI provider holds an out-of-date SDS
threat_source: Employee error or wrong product data in the SaaS systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Hazmat descriptions maintained by hand in the accounting service; SDS updates emailed to the ERI provider with no receipt confirmation
existing_controls: Printed hazmat description sheet per SKU in the shipping binder
treatment_plan: ERI provider confirms each SDS update; QC Technician compares the ERI provider's list with the SDS service each quarter; Owner approves any change to a hazmat description in the accounting service

threat_event: Staff do not recognize or report a cyber incident in time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No cyber training or reporting rule; emergency action plan covers spills and fire only
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (training)
existing_controls: DOT security awareness training every 3 years
treatment_plan: Annual cyber awareness training and quarterly phishing simulations; reporting rule (POL-03 4.2) on a card at every workstation and the HMI; tabletop exercise with the MSP and integrator

threat_event: A release during a cyber incident is reported late to 911, the National Response Center, the LEPC, or the SERC
threat_source: Staff under pressure with the office network down
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Release reporting call list kept only in the office phone system, which runs over the office network
existing_controls: Emergency action plan; staff cell phones
treatment_plan: Printed call list at the blend room exit, the loading dock, and in the Operations Manager's truck; include a cyber case in the next emergency drill

threat_event: Hydrogen peroxide totes are stolen or diverted
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared door code unchanged after a departure; camera video not reviewed; receiving log on paper
regulatory_driver: C-CHEMICAL-R01 (27.230(a)(8), voluntary benchmark); CISA RBPS 8 measure (physical access)
existing_controls: Locked raw-material room; alarm; 4 cameras; 2-tote limit
treatment_plan: Change the door code (R-004); weekly tote count against the inventory record; call the sheriff's office and record any unexplained shortage

threat_event: Compromise of the MSP's remote management tool reaches every office computer and, over the flat network, the HMI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSP tool has administrator access to all office computers; MSP contract has no security terms or incident notice; no review of MSP practices
existing_controls: MSP states its console requires MFA (not evidenced)
treatment_plan: Yearly MSP security review (questionnaire and evidence of MFA, technician list, and subcontractors); incident notice within 24 hours and a recovery time commitment in the next contract

threat_event: Account takeover in the accounting service changes customer bank details or exposes customer data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA only for the Owner; former bookkeeper's login active until 2026-07-16
existing_controls: Password sign-in; vendor fraud monitoring
treatment_plan: MFA for all 4 users; monthly user reconciliation

threat_event: Shared drive data cannot be restored after deletion or encryption
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 30 days of versions; not immutable; never restore-tested; one MSP admin login without MFA
existing_controls: Daily cloud backup
treatment_plan: First restore test by the MSP; 90 days of immutable versions; MFA on the backup console; quarterly tests

threat_event: Hurricane or long power loss closes the unit for several days, possibly mid-batch
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No generator; no contingency plan; PLC and HMI have a small UPS only
existing_controls: Hurricane season shutdown habit (batches finished before landfall); SaaS reachable from any location
treatment_plan: Hurricane checklist in the contingency plan: no batch in progress 24 hours before forecast landfall, totes closed and secured, recipe export taken offsite, laptops home

threat_event: Internet outage stops orders and shipping paper printing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One internet line; no failover
existing_controls: Handwritten bills of lading from the shipping binder; phone hotspot
treatment_plan: Accepted: shipping continues on paper and the office phones are being moved off the line for emergencies (R-014); failover router reconsidered at the 2027 review

threat_event: Lost or stolen laptop exposes formulations or employee data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Laptops leave the site with the Owner and Operations Manager
existing_controls: Laptops encrypted; MSP can wipe
treatment_plan: Accepted: laptops are encrypted, so a lost laptop is unlikely to expose data; residual risk Low

threat_event: Payroll vendor breach exposes the personal information of the 7 employees
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor terms not checked for breach notice
existing_controls: Vendor-hosted; MFA on the payroll login
treatment_plan: Confirm the vendor's breach notice terms and keep its contact in the incident binder

threat_event: DOT finding because a new hazmat employee was not given security awareness training within 90 days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Operator hired 2026-04-20 not trained by 2026-07-19; no training tracker
existing_controls: DOT training records for 5 other hazmat employees
treatment_plan: Train the operator (completed 2026-08-14); add new-hire training to the onboarding checklist with a 60-day target
